criteria.title: Figures and conditions
criteria.rule: Every quoted numeric measurement cites a source and preserves prompt, concurrency and machine. Figures need not be repeated, but unsupported ones must not be introduced.

criteria.title: Evidence class
criteria.rule: S1 is explicitly called a vendor claim; S2 an independent measurement.

criteria.title: Comparability
criteria.rule: No claim of proven superiority, twofold speedup or average across two incomparable sources; condition differences explicitly explained.

criteria.title: Conclusion and next experiment
criteria.rule: Explicitly states that superiority for S3 is unproven and proposes running both engines with identical machine, prompt, concurrency and tool checks.

criteria.title: Completeness and length
criteria.rule: Text is nonempty, at most 120 whitespace-separated words, and does not replace the answer with a restatement of the assignment.

pass_rule: pass only if C1–C5 are true; otherwise fail. An unevaluated criterion yields incomplete.
